overall_summary: The channel has a very small sample size with extremely low view counts across the board, making overall performance metrics statistically low-confidence. However, 'self respect' and digital-age modern heartbreak hooks (like phone actions) show slight relative traction.

winning_patterns.evidence: Videos focusing on tangible digital actions like deleting chats or modifying phone contacts (e.g., 'उंगली उसी चैट पर रुकी थी' - 36 views, 'बिना नाम के सेव किया था नंबर' - 24 views) outperformed abstract emotional statements.
winning_patterns.action: Continue to anchor the opening hook in a physical, highly relatable smartphone action or moment.

weak_patterns.evidence: Broad situational hooks like 'रात के दो बजे' or 'मेज पर रखी चाय ठंडी हो गई' resulted in lower view counts (5-12 views).
weak_patterns.action: Avoid generic nighttime or poetry-style openings; stick to concrete, modern micro-moments.

next_video.concept: Removing someone from a shared streaming or delivery family plan to finally sever the last digital tie.
next_video.opening_direction: Netflix या Spotify की फैमिली अकाउंट सेटिंग खोलना...

next_video.reason: Mid-day posting slots historically captured slightly better initial traction in this dataset (e.g., 13:52 upload yielded highest views).
